Description

When a lag spike hits there is about a 30% chance I can no longer hear or talk to people unless I restart vrchat.

Reproduction Steps

Restarting VrChat makes everything normal again but it happens again about 20 minutes later and is very annoying

Details

- Category: Audio

- Frequency: Often
